question: Can supreme consecration occur without elaborate external ritual procedures?
premises: Supreme consecration is affirmed as real.
It can occur even without other ritual sequences.
It can take place in many supports such as body, altar, liṅga, vessel, water, or fire.
inference: The highest consecration is not limited to external ritual sequences and can be realized in diverse supports.
uncertainties: The reading jale@nale is ambiguous and may reflect a textual variant.
plain_english: Indeed, the supreme consecration can occur even without other ritual sequences, whether in the body, on the altar-ground, in the liṅga, in a vessel, or in water or fire.
